source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Most of the changes look great, but minting still is not functioning.

When I attempt to mint, there is no option to select payment in ETH/USDC/etc, even though my wallet contains both ETH and USDC, and the first mint continues to fail...

My dashboard also continues to say that I own 2 NFTs, but clicking 'read' for these false NFTs does not lead anywhere.

execution.observed_behavior: The connected wallet contained both ETH and USDC, but the mint interface provided no payment-currency selection.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
When payment supports only ETH (or only USDC), the customer must be informed which currency the payment uses.

However, if both ETH and USDC are available as alternatives, there must be a way to choose between them.

value_updates.single_currency_disclosure: When only one payment currency is supported, inform the customer which currency the payment uses.
value_updates.multiple_currency_selection: When both ETH and USDC are available, allow the customer to choose between them.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: At the moment, 'View Book' still opens a blank page for me (see the attached screenshot), and I cannot choose to pay in ETH—I can only select USDC or Card. Card, however, should be the option I cannot select because it has not been implemented yet.

execution.observed_behavior: The mint interface offered USDC and Card but did not allow the client to select the accepted ETH payment option.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
[ACCOUNT_001] My NFTs have stopped appearing in the dashboard.
[ACCOUNT_001] I can choose ETH as the payment method, but the transaction failed.

The dashboard still says we have reached mint number 3, while also showing that the prize pool is now empty; see screenshots.

execution.observed_behavior: The client was able to choose ETH as the payment method in the mint interface.

routing_warnings.description: The continued failure of the first mint concerns primary mint execution rather than payment-method selection.
The two false NFT ownership records concern dashboard listing accuracy.
Card remaining selectable despite not being implemented concerns availability gating rather than selection among implemented currencies.
The blank View Book page concerns the ebook reader.
The failed transaction after selecting ETH concerns execution of the ETH mint flow.
NFTs disappearing from the dashboard concerns dashboard listing accuracy.
The inconsistent mint number and empty prize-pool display concern aggregate statistics.
